title: GTA 6 players are doomscrolling... IN the game #gta6 #shorts
description: GTA 6's in-game phone has a social feed with viral videos and influencers, and players report getting stuck scrolling it. Sources: VGC (retail listing), news reports.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.title: STUCK ON A FAKE PHONE
scenes.say: GTA 6 players are doomscrolling on a phone that isn't even real.

scenes.speaker: a
scenes.say: The in-game phone has a social feed with viral videos and influencers.

scenes.speaker: b
scenes.say: Meanwhile the cops are right there, and you're still scrolling.

scenes.speaker: c
scenes.say: Players say they put down the real phone, just to pick up the fake one.

scenes.speaker: c
scenes.say: Art imitating life. How long have you scrolled in game?
